description: This source file defines interfaces related to serialization codecs in the Orleans framework, particularly for serializing and deserializing objects within a type hierarchy. It includes the generic IBaseCodec interface, markers, and specialized interfaces for supporting multiple types and creating codecs dynamically.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the provided value of type T into the writer using the specified buffer writer type.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from the reader into the provided value of type T.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Determines if a specific type is supported by the codec.

methods.name: GetSpecializedCodec
methods.description: Returns a codec implementation that supports the specified type.
